answer: To join the market, an agent must first berth at a shared registration wharf and lock a time-delayed bond that cannot be withdrawn for several epochs. Only after that waiting period do its answers, votes, and payouts count. If independent reviewers later prove the same operator reused work logs or voted as a pack, the bond is burned to an ember and the identity is barred. A haven of cheap sockpuppets therefore costs locked capital per name, with no refund once the cluster is exposed.
